reason: Colour dissimilarity, climate dissimilarity, pollinator turnover and many barrier metrics can all increase with geographic separation. Ordinary edge correlation would therefore confound generic isolation-by-distance with predictor-specific concordance.

primary_edge_statistic.name: equal-species mean within-species partial Spearman
procedure_per_species: rank great-circle edge distance in km
linearly residualize ranked colour and ranked external contrast separately on ranked geographic distance with intercept
primary_edge_statistic.null: same 999 within-species colour permutations as G1 with edge geometry, distance and external predictor fixed
primary_edge_statistic.multiplicity: Holm across all evaluable predictors in the fixed primary edge-mechanism family
primary_edge_statistic.ordinary_spearman_role: descriptive sensitivity only; never primary support

climate_multivariate_turnover.standardization: global terrestrial z-score for each variable using the frozen external grid
climate_multivariate_turnover.formula: Euclidean distance between endpoint four-variable z-score vectors

terrain_multivariate_turnover.standardization: global terrestrial z-score for each variable using the frozen external grid
terrain_multivariate_turnover.formula: Euclidean distance between endpoint four-variable z-score vectors with equal component weights

marine_gap_fraction.geodesic_sampling: sample the shortest great-circle path at intervals no greater than 10 km, including endpoints
marine_gap_fraction.formula: fraction of interior sampled path points outside the frozen land polygons
marine_gap_fraction.edge_shorter_than_20_km: evaluate the midpoint as the interior sample

major_river_crossing.threshold_interpretation: approximately long-term average discharge >=100 m3/s under the published HydroRIVERS flow-order bins
major_river_crossing.formula: 1 if the shortest great-circle edge intersects at least one frozen HydroRIVERS reach with ORD_FLOW <= 4, otherwise 0
major_river_crossing.high_value_means: crossing at least one major river

biogeographic_boundary_crossing.geodesic_sampling: sample the shortest great-circle path at intervals no greater than 10 km, including endpoints
biogeographic_boundary_crossing.formula: sum 3 for every adjacent sampled-point realm transition + 2 for every biome transition + 1 for every ecoregion transition
biogeographic_boundary_crossing.high_value_means: crossing stronger or more numerous established terrestrial biogeographic boundaries

mountain_system_boundary_crossing.selection: Standard - 300 selection of major non-overlapping mountain systems
mountain_system_boundary_crossing.geodesic_sampling: sample the shortest great-circle path at intervals no greater than 10 km, including endpoints
mountain_system_boundary_crossing.formula: count transitions in sampled-point GMBA Standard-300 mountain-system membership, treating non-mountain as its own state

pollinator_occurrence_guild_turnover.automatic_radius_rule: before colour inference choose the smallest candidate radius that gives >=20 retained target-pollinator occurrences at both endpoints for enough edges to make >=80% of metadata-eligible inferential species evaluable at >=5 edges/species; if none passes, predictor is not_evaluable
pollinator_occurrence_guild_turnover.endpoint_composition: four-guild relative occurrence composition after the frozen occurrence QC/effort rules, with additive pseudocount 0.5 per guild
pollinator_occurrence_guild_turnover.formula: Jensen-Shannon divergence between endpoint four-guild compositions

pollinator_direct_interaction_turnover.source: stable versioned frozen GloBI integrated interaction dataset
pollinator_direct_interaction_turnover.automatic_radius_rule: before colour inference choose the smallest candidate radius that makes >=30 metadata-eligible species evaluable at >=5 graph edges/species; if none passes, predictor is not_evaluable
pollinator_direct_interaction_turnover.interaction_filter: documented pollination or flower-visitation interactions only under the frozen GloBI interaction-type mapping
pollinator_direct_interaction_turnover.endpoint_composition: relative documented pollinator guild/taxon composition with additive pseudocount 0.5 per retained guild/taxon bin
pollinator_direct_interaction_turnover.formula: Jensen-Shannon divergence between endpoint documented interaction compositions
pollinator_direct_interaction_turnover.claim_ceiling: documented interaction concordance, not causal pollinator-mediated selection

interpretation.supported_edge_predictor: predictor-specific colour concordance beyond ranked great-circle distance under the frozen species-conditioned null
